instruction: Pull over behind the white van directly ahead.
paraphrases: Stop behind the white van in front of us.|Follow the white van ahead and pull over behind it.

instruction: Pass the white vehicle at the left edge, then stop near the beige SUV on the right.
paraphrases: Go past the left-edge white vehicle and pull over by the beige SUV on the right.|After the white vehicle on the left, stop beside the right-hand beige SUV.

instruction: Stop beside the pedestrian next to the white sedan ahead on the left.
